headline: What Are the Biggest Mistakes to Avoid With Your Los Angeles ADU?
articleBody:
An ADU can be a great investment, but a few common missteps can cause major headaches, delays, and budget overruns. Knowing what to watch out for is the key to a smooth project. We've seen it all, and we're here to help you steer clear of the biggest pitfalls.

One of the most frequent mistakes is assuming any backyard spot will work without properly checking the specific zoning rules for your area. This can lead to a design that gets rejected by the city. Another major issue is underestimating utility needs. Your ADU is a full-fledged home that needs its own sewer, water, and power connections. You have to make sure your existing systems can handle the extra load or budget for necessary upgrades. We also see clients who don't plan for construction access, which can create logistical nightmares. Finally, be realistic about timelines. The city's plan check and inspection process takes time, and expecting to be done in a few weeks is just not feasible.

A dedicated ADU contractor is crucial because they can anticipate these issues from the start. They'll navigate the permits, coordinate with utility companies, and manage the entire process. At YOR Construction & Investments, Inc., we specialize in building ADUs in the Los Angeles area and can help you avoid these costly mistakes. Give us a call to get started!
